Create PROCEDURE D360.Hash_Logs_CountOnly

AS
BEGIN
CREATE TABLE #tbl
WITH
( DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN
)
AS
SELECT  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS Sequence
,       [name]
,       'WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT COUNT(*) COUNT_TGT, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.'+name+' WHERE H = ''D''
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM
)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,''F-'','''') COUNT_SRC, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.'+name+' WHERE H <> ''D''
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,''_SRC'','''') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT *
FROM CTE12
) src

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT )
) pvt2' 
 AS sql_code
FROM    sys.tables  WHERE NAME LIKE 'STG_%' and schema_id = 9 and name not like '%logging' and name not in ('STG_ZIPCODEMAPPING','STG_ATM_ACCOUNT','STG_BOB_TBLPAYROLL'
,'STG_CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC','STG_CRM_CORPMISCELLANEOUSINFO','STG_CRM_ACCOUNTS','STG_CRM_AMLKYC','STG_CRM_CORPORATE','STG_CRM_FINANCIAL','STG_CRM_FINANCIALDETAILS','STG_CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD','STG_CRM_CUSTOMER','STG_CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO'
,'STG_CCD_DCUSTOMER','STG_CCD_MCUSTOMER'
,'STG_CCD_CBCEXAPPFP','STG_CCD_CBCEXAPPMP'
,'STG_CCD_CBCEXCACCP','STG_CCD_CBCEXCACFP'
,'STG_CCD_CBCEXCARDP','STG_CCD_CBCEXCARFP'
,'STG_LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN'
,'STG_LNS_CCOLTRLLNKMNT'
,'STG_LNS_COLTRLIPROPDT'
,'STG_LNS_CUSTGENCUSTACMASTER'
,'STG_LNS_ENTITYFEEASSESS'
,'STG_LNS_ENTITYINTEREST'
,'STG_LNS_EODACCTBAL'
,'STG_LNS_GENERALACCTMAST'
,'STG_LNS_LAACCTMAST'
,'STG_LNS_LADMD'
,'STG_LNS_LAPENALDMD'
,'STG_LNS_LAREPSHDL'
,'STG_LNS_LASHDLBALANCE'
,'STG_LNS_LIMITLIAB'
,'STG_LNS_POSTDATEDCHQ'
,'STG_LNS_SECUDETAILRGTR'
,'STG_LNS_STANDALONECOLLMNT'
,'STG_SEC_PORTFOLIO'
,'STG_RIB_CORPORATEUSER','STG_TRU_AUMUITF','STG_TRU_AUMNONUITF','STG_TRU_PORTFOLIO','STG_TRY_TRADES')
;


DECLARE @nbr_statements INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #tbl)
,       @i INT = 1
;

WHILE   @i <= @nbr_statements
BEGIN
    DECLARE @sql_code NVARCHAR(4000) = (SELECT sql_code FROM #tbl WHERE Sequence = @i);
    EXEC    sp_executesql @sql_code;
    SET     @i +=1;
END

DROP TABLE #tbl;
END
